title: Brookhaven op script new 2026
features:
🏙️ Brookhaven RP Ultimate – Feature Showcase
The most advanced roleplay script for Brookhaven – packed with immersive features, premium customization, and zero lag.

🎭 Roleplay Enhancements
Custom Animations – Over 50 unique emotes and animations: sitting, dancing, waving, sleeping, pointing, and more. Fully searchable.

Emote Wheel – Quick‑access radial menu for instant roleplay actions.

Walk Styles – Change your character's walking animation: gangster, casual, elegant, energetic, zombie, and more.

Voice Lines – Play custom audio clips (pre‑loaded) to add personality to your character: laughs, cries, greetings, shouts.

Emoji Reactions – Floating emojis above your head that other players can see.

👗 Character Customization
Outfit Presets – Save up to 10 custom outfits and switch between them instantly.

Color Palette – Change your character's skin color, hair color, and clothing colors with a color picker.

Accessory Editor – Equip, rotate, and scale hats, glasses, wings, and more.

Name Display – Show a custom roleplay name above your head (different from your Roblox username).

Age Changer – Instantly change your character's height and proportions for child/teen/adult roleplay.

🏠 Housing & Building
Property Scraper – Instantly find and teleport to any available house in Brookhaven.

Quick Buy – Automatically purchase the house you're standing near with one click.

Furniture Spawner – Spawn any furniture item in the game directly into your house.

Car Spawner – Spawn any vehicle (cars, boats, planes) right in front of you.

Unlock All Doors – Enter any building, locked house, or restricted area.

🚗 Vehicle Features
Vehicle Scraper – Find the nearest vehicle and teleport directly inside it.

Speed Boost – Increase your vehicle's top speed up to 3x.

Infinite Fuel – Never run out of gas.

Vehicle Flip – Instantly flip your car if it's upside down.

Car Spawn – Spawn any car from a list of all vehicles in the game.

🔧 Utility & Automation
Auto‑Walk – Set a destination (player, marker, or coordinates) and your character walks there automatically.

Auto‑Eat – Automatically consumes food when hunger drops below a set threshold.

Auto‑Sleep – Automatically sleeps when energy is low.

Fast Travel – Teleport to any location on the map using a custom list of waypoints.

Quick Shop – Buy items from any shop instantly without walking.

👀 Visuals & Immersion
First Person – Toggle first‑person camera with adjustable FOV.

Cinematic Mode – Smooth, slow camera movements for cinematic roleplay scenes.

Depth of Field – Blurs the background to make your character stand out.

Vignette – Adds a subtle dark border for a more immersive feel.

Motion Blur – Smooth motion effect when moving quickly.

🛡️ Anti‑Detection & Safety
GUI Hotkey – Show/hide the GUI instantly with F12.

Script Killer – Disable all features and clear memory with one button (panic mode).

AFK Simulator – Moves your mouse slightly to prevent being kicked for inactivity.

Log Cleaner – Removes any traces of the script after execution.

Undetectable – Uses obfuscated memory injection to bypass anti‑exploit systems.

🎨 User Interface
Glass‑morphism GUI – Sleek, modern, draggable interface with animated transitions.

Dark/Light Mode – Switch between themes.

Search Bar – Find any feature instantly.

Real‑time Clock – Displays in‑game time and your current FPS.

Save/Load Config – Save your favorite settings and load them with one click.

⚡ Performance
Lightweight – Uses < 1% CP
